title: Unavailable tools in the TikTok for Business MCP Server on Claude Connector Directory
content_data:
You can [connect the TikTok for Business MCP Server to Claude](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/how-to-connect-claude-to-tiktok-for-business-mcp-server/v1.3) either through the Claude Connector Directory or via manually specified server URLs. While the Connector Directory offers a streamlined setup, it includes a restricted set of tools compared to the manual configuration. Review the list of excluded tools below to ensure you choose the connection method that supports your workflow requirements. ## Tools based on TikTok API for Business endpoints > **Note**
> For detailed parameter schemas and usage information for any of these tools, search for the corresponding endpoint in the [TikTok API for Business documentation](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/api-reference/v1.3). ```xtable |Category{16%}|Tool Name{28%}|API Endpoint{20%}|Available for MCP server from manual addition{18%}|Available
